name: Chicken pad thai
steps: Soak the rice noodles in hot water until pliable, then drain.
Stir-fry the sliced chicken in a hot oiled wok until golden.
Push the chicken aside, scramble the egg, then toss in the noodles.
Add fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice and toss to coat.
Fold through the bean sprouts and finish with crushed peanuts.
